Write this pull request in English. Repository content, commit messages and PR text are all in English.

## Summary

What this pull request does and why, in your own words.

## Type of change

Pick one and delete the rest.

- [ ] New site reference (`docs(sites): add <name>`)
- [ ] Site page update (re-checked against the live site)
- [ ] Topic hub change
- [ ] Skill change (`skills/`)
- [ ] Website change (`site/`)
- [ ] Build or script change (`scripts/`)
- [ ] Documentation or workflow change
- [ ] Release bump

## Verification

Delete the lines that do not apply. Check the boxes you actually ran.

- [ ] `bun run build` passes
- [ ] `bun run check` passes
- [ ] `bun run site:build` passes (when the website or page links changed)
- [ ] `bun run evals` passes (when a skill changed; say which cases ran)
- [ ] Generated content was produced by the build, not edited by hand (`llms.txt`, `sites.json`, hub source lists, skill catalog and search index)
- [ ] Live site checked on the `reviewed` date (for new or updated site pages)

## AI assistance

Say whether an AI helped, and confirm a person checked every fact against the live site.

- [ ] No AI assistance, or AI assisted and a person checked every fact against the live site on the `reviewed` date.

## Notes

Anything a reviewer should know: skipped checks, known limitations, follow-ups.
